topics.text: Rooms are consistently described as clean, odor-free, and well-ventilated, even during rainy weather. The presence of mosquito nets and the absence of mold or dampness are highlighted, ensuring a comfortable stay.

Free breakfast with home-style dishes is a standout feature, complemented by additional services like barbecue equipment and recommendations for local activities. The host’s hospitality, such as preparing special meals, adds to the experience.

address: No.76 Kanshang, Houwu Village, Deqing, Zhejiang, China
priceRange: Unbeatable daily deals - quickly find great rates for your ideal stay. And if it's cheaper elsewhere, we'll refund the difference.

comments.quote: 住了兩晚，非常舒服，特別放鬆。老闆做的飯真的很好吃，而且價格真的很划算，比旁邊的飯店優惠好多，也省去了自己還想着晚上吃什麼。民宿的小露台是我和老婆的最愛，連着在露台喝酒聊天兩晚，微風吹過，好不愜意。最重要的還可以挖春筍，後山就可以挖，非常方便！
comments.author: Guest User
comments.quoteEn: Two nights, very comfortable and very relaxing. The owner cooks genuinely well and the prices are a bargain, much better than the restaurants nearby, and it saves you wondering what to do about dinner. The little terrace was my wife's favourite and mine, and we sat drinking and talking on it both evenings with a breeze coming through. Best of all you can dig spring bamboo shoots on the hill right behind the house.

comments.quote: 房間乾淨舒適，安靜好睡，整體佈置很用心。早餐雖然簡單但味道很好，吃得舒服。 最加分的是老闆，特別熱情實在，從入住到離開都照顧得很周到，還主動幫忙規劃路線，這種有人情味的住宿，下次一定再來！
comments.author: Guest User

comments.quote: 環境還可以，環境適合愛打麻將的小夥伴！莫干山適合徒步愛好者，空氣新鮮！這家民宿包含早餐，睡得晚了，還可以讓老闆幫忙保留一下！
